definition: Radius from the M31 centre to which its extended rotating disc-like structure spans, from a Keck/DEIMOS kinematic survey of more than 2800 stars; scattered detections reach 70 kpc.
quote: The stellar structure spans radii from 15 kpc out to ~40 kpc
presentation: Where the galaxy's stars are still measured: while the camera is inside this radius the galaxy's caption hides; outside it the caption hangs under what is drawn of the galaxy. Not a boundary.
